notes.title: Update on 3rd of June.
notes.notes:
On the 3rd of June the game will receive a massive update.

Significant parts of the game were remade from the ground up, a detailed list of changes will be provided with the update when it goes live.

IMPORTANT!

Existing save games will NOT be usable after the update.

Due to how the game was coded originally, and how awful the existing save system is, existing save games will be unusable. I apologize for the inconvenience but there was no easy way to offer a legacy load option.

[url=https://discord.gg/REKcMkf]Join our Discord![/url]

notes.title: Moonless Knight release date!
notes.notes:
October 31st 2019.

Yes, in two months.

I could release early October but I rather make sure I polish it up as much as possible. 
It already contains more options and comfort settings than all 3 of my games combined, which is hard as the engine can be a total headache.

Overall this game will feature the widest spectrum of gameplay styles of my games yet, with the absolute most open structure yet. More open than basically any Metroidvania, but not falling over the edge into open world.

Please look forward to the release and make sure to wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029170/Skautfold_Moonless_Knight/

It has been a really hard time for me both due to financial difficulties and struggling with depression, still I feel like this will be by far my best work yet.

notes.title: Into the Fray release date set.
notes.notes:
[b]December 5th.[/b]

[i]Into the Fray[/i] will be leaving Early Access on the 5th of December.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

The game is a direct sequel to both [i]Shrouded in Sanity[/i] and [i]Usurper[/i], and features Hito the 3rd Knight as the protagonist.

The game will receive post launch support in the form of more modes and silly extras, but the release version will already feature a lot of extras. Like the obvious Steam stuff like Achievements and Trading cards.

Once out of EA development on the next game begins immediately, while ItF will receive periodic smaller additions to tie over. No DLC plans. If you are interested in the 4th game in the series you can always pop into our Discord and take a look and have your say, discord users had a lot of influence on me over the last game.

Additionally Christmas will bring a nice surprise regarding [i]Usurper[/i] if everything goes well, as a thank you to all who support my weird series of games with different genres each time.

notes.title: Sequel nearing release.
notes.notes:
[b]Into the Fray[/b], the sequel to [b]Shrouded in Sanity[/b] and [b]Usurper[/b] is nearing its completion in Early Access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

Mandatory story content is nearly finished, and the gameplay is getting polished to a close to final version, an RPG mode was also implemented to make it more for for those who like to create builds.

Final release is expected in 2-3 weeks, with a lot of optional content and a lot of post release content planned, even the possibility of a 2 player local versus mode.

notes.title: Bugfixes.

Update on bugs.
notes.notes:
I have noticed the addition of the Survival mode has introduced some new and rather bizarre bugs and issues on systems that had no issues before. Additionally there are some issues related to the final round of the Survival mode. 

So I'd like to assure everyone I will be doing my best to fix all these issues as soon as I can. I tested the survival mode multiple times over and I am very sad to see these bugs. 

I considered a re-roll to an earlier version of the game until they are fixed, but I rather ask that you bear with me until they are fixed, and I apologize for any issues caused.

Shrouded in Sanity - OST DLC Ready for release!
notes.notes:
That's right, at long last the OST DLC is ready for release.
Originally I planned for it to be ready for May, but various issues and events have had to be given higher priority,  so huge apologies to those of you who have asked for this and waited patiently for all that time.

Anyway, I'm pleased to announce that all being well (with the acceptance through Steam), the DLC will be available for download on the [b]14th October[/b]! (Price to be confirmed when accepted by Steam.)

The DLC will include over 49 minutes of music, including 2 bonus tracks. Here's the full list:
[list]
    [*] Beckoned Fog (Title Music)
    [*] Blade of Faithless (Gray - The Second Knight)
    [*] Swift Judgement (Hito - The Third Knight)
    [*] Dance of Blades (Saragat - The Fourth Knight)
    [*] The Executioner (Len - The First Knight)
    [*] Lost Promise (The King)
    [*] Under Duress (Opening Scene)
    [*] The Messenger (The Monolith)
    [*] The Fog Has Lifted (Credits)
    [*] Fall of the Manor (Bonus Track 1)
    [*] The Curse of Berelaai (Bonus Track 2)
[/list]

I will mention it again when it is released, but to access the files once you have bought the DLC, you will need to navigate to the steamapps folder for Shrouded in Sanity. Let's just say Steam makes things very awkward sometimes! Just in case you don't know how to navigate there, I will explain on the next announcement when the OST DLC is released.

Thanks (and sorry for the delay),
Jamie Warne (The composer for SiS' soundtrack)

P.s. Please feel free to ask any questions.

notes.title: Keyboard rebind and more UPDATE.
notes.notes:
Added;

---Keyboard rebind.
---Soundcue for Len's instakill attack.


Changes;

---Len boss AI reworked, her death casting starts at lower hp.
---Gate to final area now spawns without having to re-enter Len's boss room.
---You can finally walk out of boss rooms without engaging them.
---Escape menu pauses the game now.


Keyboard rebind is an essential function to give, when I wrote the original code to SiS it was very fragmented, and GMS had issues with WIN10, now that those are fixed, I spent a lot of time to integrate the rebind code I am using in the "sequel of SiS.

I am deeply sorry it took this long to fix.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Fixed;

---Various spelling mistakes fixed, if you still find any I'd be very grateful if you report them.

Changes;

---After critical stabs enemies will no longer counterattack immediately, giving you almost 1.5 seconds to move out of the way,



Implemented;

----Saragat mode finished. He cant shoot, but can leave a copy of himself using the heavy attack.

----Gray mode finished, He can place flames around him using the heavy attack, and can call down lightning by consuming ammo, striking the closest enemy.

---Hito mode finished, His light attack is replaced by a short burst of bullets, it will NOT consume ammo. He lacks a heavy attack, but when aiming he enters sniping mode, any enemy hit in this mode will die immediately, it does consume ammo.

They are implemented, but NOT unlocked yet, once Len is finished I'll unlock all 4 of them at once. You will need a save file (or the achievement if you destroyed or overwritten the save) with the appropriate bosses defeated to unlock their modes for the main menu. You must start a new game with the bosses, but they have different starting stats to Veimar.

Boss modes can be expected in 2 days, unfortunately I had really bad hardware issues (broken motherboard memory slot, it took a while to figure out the issue.)

Thank you for reading and have fun.

notes.title: Free DLC incoming / linux version news.
notes.notes:
Free dlc "4 knights" is incoming in a week.
It will allow you to play as any of the four main bosses of the game. The story and upgrade system will not change, but each one will act as their boss versions, so very overpowered :) This is a thank you for everyone who brought the game, a way to get back and punish all the enemies, and bosses.

Linux version news, I finally acquired the necessary second hardware to port it, the port should be done within a week if no issued arise.

notes.title: Update 12 Live. New Game Plus.
notes.notes:
Implemented;

---New Game Plus.

To access it defeat the final boss, and watch the credits, after it you will be offered the option to start new game plus.

changes to new game plus are as follows;

---Enemies are much more frequent.
---Traps are much more frequent.
---Enemy Hp values doubled. 
---Enemy dmg doubled.
---Boss dmg doubled.
---Boss Hp values are 2.5 times higher.
---All enemies and bosses are faster.
---Darkness levels increased.
---Added 5 extra Yth stones as a present, you`ll find them don't worry.

What carries over?

---Upgrades to stats
---Any Yth stones you have on you.
---Any Vitae you have on you.
---Sanity level.
---Blessings accumulated from the priest.

What resets?

---Game day timer resets.
---All npcs reset.
---All keys reset.
---All Butlers reset.
---All relics reset.

Added two achievements, one for starting New Game Plus, one for defeating the final boss in New Game Plus.

Warning, New Game Plus is really brutal.

notes.title: Update 8 Live.
notes.notes:
Changes;

---Save system altered, now saving at Waltham will "respawn" the world and refill all your healing injections, ammo and current hp, much like in souls, however there is a hidden penalty.

---Healing injections will now also recover stamina at a very high rate, allowing for multi purpose use, in case you somehow have to many.

---The much requested shooting without aiming feature.
Now you`ll fire your gun upon releasing the aiming key. So you can still aim and walk around, but can also instantly fire if you want, best of both worlds.
NOTE; Will have to alter the menu screen to reflect the change.

Fixes;

---few minor spelling errors.

notes.title: Update 4 Live, experimental battle system.
notes.notes:
Battle system overhaul.

Introducing the Guard resource.
This new resource will server as your first line of defense. When taking damage if you have guard left that will take the hit, instead of your health.

Guard is regained automatically similar to stamina, however, dodging through attacks or a successful parry will regain a lot more guard immediately.

All actions cost guard, however even if  your guard is under zero, you can still preform all actions, as opposed to stamina. This allows you to escape, or push more, but also risk taking damage.

This is an experimental update, previous version is archived and can be restored easily. If this version proves unpopular rollback is possible.

Thank you for reading and hope you`ll find the new system more rewarding.
